# More Room for Together: GenSmart Suites® for Multigenerational Living and Guests


Tri Pointe Homes


•


November 19, 2026


Share this article


The best holiday visits make room for both time together and the comfort of a place to settle in. Whether family is staying for a long weekend or several generations share a home year-round, a thoughtful floorplan can make everyday moments and special occasions feel more comfortable for everyone.


At Tri Pointe Homes®, the GenSmart Suite **®** is designed with flexibility in mind. This dedicated space can support multigenerational living, welcome overnight guests, and adapt as your needs change. Here are a few ways it can help your home make room for more of life.


## **What is a GenSmart Suite?**


A GenSmart Suite includes a first-floor bedroom and dedicated bathroom, creating a comfortable living space within the home. Depending on the floorplan, it may also offer features or options such as a lounge area, kitchenette, laundry, or separate entrance.


The possibilities vary by home, community, and floorplan. A Tri Pointe Homes New Home Advisor can help you understand which features are included and which options may be available.


## **Help overnight holiday guests feel at home**


Holiday hosting often means more than gathering around the table. It can also mean making space for a relative visiting from out of town or friends staying a few extra nights. A GenSmart Suite gives guests a dedicated place to unpack, rest, and enjoy a little quiet time between shared meals and celebrations.


## **Make room for multigenerational living**


Multigenerational living can look different for every household. Some people share a home with relatives across generations, while others welcome loved ones for extended stays.


A home with a GenSmart Suite can provide a dedicated area for a family member while keeping shared spaces close by. Gather for dinner in the kitchen or catch up in the living room, then enjoy the comfort of having separate space when it is time to unwind. The right layout depends on your household, so consider how much privacy, accessibility and proximity to shared areas will work for the people who will use it.


## **Give your home flexibility beyond the holidays**


The way you use your home may change over time. A suite that welcomes holiday guests today could later become a home office, a place for hobbies or a space for a family member. Consider how the layout will support your current routines as well as the possibilities ahead.


When exploring a floorplan, ask which features are included and what options are available. Depending on the home and stage of construction, a New Home Advisor can help explain your choices and opportunities to personalize.


## **Bring everyone together in the spaces you share**


A dedicated suite is just one part of a home designed for connection. A spacious kitchen island can offer a place to prepare a favorite recipe together, while an inviting dining area or open living room makes room for conversations to continue long after the meal.


As you tour Tri Pointe homes, think about how your household and guests will move between private and shared spaces. The right combination can make your home feel welcoming during the holidays and comfortable throughout the year.


## **Find a home that fits the way you live**


Whether you are planning for multigenerational living or want a welcoming place for overnight guests, explore Tri Pointe Homes communities and ask a New Home Advisor about available floorplans with a GenSmart Suite. Together, you can find a home with room for the people and moments that matter to you.
